adjudication.rationale: The migration `20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb` inserts rows via raw SQL: `INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts (host, ...) VALUES ('#{h}', ...)`, so it bypasses the `EmbeddableHost` model’s `before_validation` normalization (`sub!(/^https?:\/\//, '')` and stripping paths). The diff also changes host checks to `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host`/`host_allowed?`, which parses the referer URL and compares `where("lower(host) = ?", uri.host)`. If legacy `site_settings.embeddable_hosts` entries included `http://discourse.org` or `https://example.com/1234` (explicitly shown as previously-accepted in updated specs), the migrated DB rows would contain those strings verbatim and would not match `uri.host` (e.g., `discourse.org`), breaking embedding after upgrade for such hosts.
